_comment: Translation units per DLL. Flags are the ones deduced from the 1.6a binaries (docs/toolchains.md). Target functions are listed by their MSVC decorated names, which tools/symbols/<dll>_1.6a.csv maps to retail addresses.

retail_objects.name: a3d
retail_objects.note: Aureal A3D library (CA3DRenderer, CA3DSource2D/3D, the hw* C entry points used by hla3d): code, .rdata (vtables, GUIDs), RTTI, EH tables, .data, .bss

retail_objects.name: mss32
retail_objects.note: MSS_auto_cleanup of the Miles mss32.lib (static member: atexit(AIL_shutdown))

retail_objects.name: radial
retail_objects.note: IGA Radial client SDK 2.0.0.0 (rad* entry points, HTTP client, cache files)

retail_objects.name: dxmgr
retail_objects.note: DirectX manager of the OpenGL-on-Direct3D wrapper with its ATL support code (DXMgrCreate, ddraw enumeration, COM registration, security descriptors), and the five interface GUIDs of its MIDL header (IID_IDXMgr and the four its ATL tables use) that sit in the engine's .rdata; IID_IDirectDraw4 and IID_IDirect3D3, which the VC6 DXGUID.LIB lacks (the Windows SDK dxguid.lib holds every GUID in one object and clashes with the VC6 one)
